ammo.compareHeadDifference: {{leader}} averages {{delta}} per shot against {{runnerUp}}, and the 95% interval ({{low}} to {{high}}) stays clear of zero — the gap is bigger than the noise.
ammo.compareHeadInconclusive: {{leader}} leads {{runnerUp}} by {{delta}} per shot, but the 95% interval ({{low}} to {{high}}) includes zero. That is not yet a difference you can act on.
ammo.compareHeadInsufficient: Too little data to compare {{leader}} with {{runnerUp}}. Both lots need at least {{count}} scored shots before a difference means anything.
ammo.compareImbalance: These lots differ {{ratio}}x in shot count, so the table is not a fair race — the lot with fewer shots has the less settled average.
ammo.compareCaveats: Shots inside one series move together, so the true uncertainty is a little wider than the intervals shown. And nothing here separates the ammunition from your own form on the day a lot happened to be used.

settings.birthYearRetroactive: You can change it later. Because the veteran class and the märke thresholds are worked out from it, changing it also changes them for sessions already logged.

settings.markeNoYearNote: No birth year set — showing full-points requirements with no age reduction.
settings.markeReductionNote: Age reduction of {{points}} p/series applies from {{sinceYear}}.
settings.locationLookupInfo:
Off: only places you have used before are suggested, and nothing leaves your phone.

On: what you type in a session’s Location field is sent to photon.komoot.io, which searches OpenStreetMap. A Use My Location button also appears there; tapping it takes one position fix and sends those coordinates to overpass-api.de to look up shooting ranges near you. Nothing is sent until you tap it, your position is never stored or tracked in the background, and only the range name you pick is saved with the session. You can turn this off again at any time.
settings.markeInfo:
Points needed per 5-shot precision series for each valör, by vapengrupp (SHB Bilaga 1 mom 5.1.1.1).

From the year after you turn 55 the requirement drops by 1 point per series, and by 2 points from the year after you turn 65. Set your birth year above to see the table with that reduction applied.
settings.trainingConsent: Keep My Marks as Training Data
settings.trainingHelp: Off by default. Nothing is sent anywhere — the marks stay on this phone.
settings.trainingInfo:
Score from Photo asks you to tap each hole. Automatic detection does not exist yet, and building it needs examples of where holes really are.

When this is on, each series you score from a photo is kept as an example: the positions you tapped, in target millimetres, and which ones you had to nudge. The photo itself is not copied — only a reference to the one already stored with the session.

This never leaves your phone. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is synced, and target photos are personal data. You can turn this off and delete everything collected at any time, without touching your logbook.
settings.trainingDeleteBody: This permanently deletes the {{count}} kept series. Your logbook and photos are not affected.

session.kindHint: Chosen once: a session either logs scored series or just a number of rounds fired. It cannot be both.
session.programInfo:
A program is the shot program inside a discipline: how many shots each series holds, whether the score is whole points or decimals, and whether the match has a final.

Choose Free Training when you are shooting the discipline without a fixed format. The series are the discipline's normal length — five shots in precision — but the session is logged as training rather than as a match, and no final is offered.

Choose the named program when you are shooting that format. One with a fixed structure lays the series out for you: militär snabbmatch arrives with a sighter series and twelve scoring series at 10, 8 and 6 seconds.

ipscTimer.sensitivityHint: Higher sensitivity (a level further from 0) picks up quieter shots, but also more background noise. Try High for .22 or indoors, Low next to a busy firing line — or use the live meter below to set it against your own shot's peak.

ipscTimer.privacyNote: The microphone is analysed live on this device to find the shots. The recording is never stored, played back or sent anywhere — it is written to a temporary file the app can only meter, and deleted the moment the run ends.

shotDiagnostics.title: Shot Detection Diagnostics
shotDiagnostics.intro: Records what the microphone hears so shot detection can be built from real measurements. Start metering, tap Mark Shot each time you fire, then export the log and send it back.
shotDiagnostics.unitHint: All values in dBFS, where 0 is the loudest the microphone can register. The noise floor follows the room, so "above floor" is how far an event separates from it.
shotDiagnostics.markHint: Tap right after each shot. The marks are what tell a real shot from a door slamming when the log is analysed.
shotDiagnostics.lastMark_one: Last shot: peak {{peak}} dBFS, {{excess}} dB above the floor, spanning {{count}} sample.
shotDiagnostics.lastMark_other: Last shot: peak {{peak}} dBFS, {{excess}} dB above the floor, spanning {{count}} samples.
shotDiagnostics.dropped: {{dropped}} older samples dropped — the buffer keeps the most recent ones.

modeHint.rangeOfficer: Ladda is called, then you press when the shooters are ready — nothing in between is on a clock. The second press starts the automatic countdown.
modeHint.solo: Automatic from Ladda, for timing yourself.

faltTimer.laddaTime: Time Between Ladda and Alla klara
faltTimer.partierHint: Whole seconds inside the shooting time — each boundary gives a short beep. The numbers above the timeline are the seconds between boundaries.
faltTimer.cuesHint: Tap to choose how each command reaches you: voice or beep, vibration, or both. Eld upphör can also be a whistle, as the rules allow. At least one stays on.
faltTimer.sourceNote: Commands and timings per SHB 2026 D.6.2 p. 88, on a timeline anchored at Eld (t = 0). Eld upphör is drawn out over the last 3 s so it ends exactly when the shooting time runs out.
faltTimer.scrubHint: Paused — tap the bar or a command to move the clock.
